reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangedAmount and getExpectedAmount, which every schedule amount path (post, actions, preview, forecast, template, API via getScheduledAmount) already calls.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated; the approximate branch becomes simpler.

placement.why: The rule changes in shared/schedules.ts where the amount rules live; call sites only get comment updates.

scope.why: The two-line rule change plus matching comment, test and release-note updates.

maintainability.why: The worst-case rule stays in one place with a comment that explains the intent.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No call site computes the amount itself.
